# obol.ovm

:::caution[v3 release candidate, unreleased]

This is the reference for `@obolnetwork/obol-sdk@3.0.0-rc.12`, generated from its source and spec. Names and shapes may still change before 3.0.0, and it is not on npm `latest`. For the released SDK see the [2.x reference](../../sdk/index.md).

:::

Reads and writes for an Obol Validator Manager: where a contract came from (`getProvenance`), its state, roles and validators, EIP-7002 withdrawal and exit requests, EIP-7251 consolidations, distributions, and the role and ownership writes. Every write checks the beacon chain request rules it can, so a request the chain would ignore (and keep the fee of) is refused before it is signed.

### ovm.getProvenance {#getProvenance}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">api+chain</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--since" title="Renamed in 3.0.0-rc.12">rc.12: was ovm.verify</span> <a class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--stage" href="../lifecycle#operate">6. Operate</a></div>

Where a contract came from: `obol` when the Obol OVM factory created it, `notObol`, or
`unknown` when that could not be checked. `source` says who vouches: `chain` (the factory's
creation log) or `api` (the Obol API alone; refused with `requireChain: true`). Called by
every OVM write and deposit.

```ts sdk-signature
obol.ovm.getProvenance(
  ovm: string,
  options?: OvmProvenanceOptions,
): Promise<OvmProvenance>
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>ovm</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |
| <code>options?</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/ovm#OvmProvenanceOptions">OvmProvenanceOptions</a></span> |  |
| <code>options.requireChain?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">boolean</span> | Accept `obol` only from the chain: when the Obol API says `obol` and its creation transaction does not confirm it, scan the factory's logs instead of returning the API's answer. [`deposits.prepareDeposit`](./deposits.md#prepareDeposit) sets it. Default false (the API's answer is returned as `source: 'api'`). |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">Promise&lt;<a href="./types/ovm#OvmProvenance">OvmProvenance</a>&gt;</span>

**Example**

```ts
const provenance = await obol.ovm.getProvenance(ovmAddress);
if (provenance.status !== 'obol') throw new Error(`not an Obol OVM: ${provenance.reason}`);
```

<details class="sdk-spec">
<summary>Specification: ovm.getProvenance</summary>

Named `ovm.verify` until 3.0.0-rc.12 (result type `OvmVerification`): it reads where a contract came from and returns
a status; it does not verify untrusted input.

Tag: `api+chain`. Inputs: `ovm: Address`, `{ requireChain: bool (false) }`. Output: `{ status: "obol" | "notObol" |
"unknown", source: Source, factoryAddress: Address, reason: string, creationTxHash: Hash32? }`. (2.16 `OVM.verify`,
launchpad rules)

`source` says who vouches for the verdict. `chain`: the caller's RPC; for `obol` that is always the factory's
`CreateObolValidatorManager` log for this address, read from the creation receipt (2.) or by the log scan (4.).
`api`: the Obol API alone. Since 3.0.0-rc.12 an `obol` / api result is only what could not be confirmed on chain,
and [`deposits.prepareDeposit`](./deposits.md#prepareDeposit) does not accept it: it calls with `requireChain: true`, which never returns
`obol` / api.

1. `getCode(ovm)`: a read error → `unknown` / chain. Empty code, or an EIP-7702 delegation (`0xef0100…`) → `notObol` /
   chain.
2. API, the OVM record `GET /v1/ovm/:network/:address`: its `provenance` is used only when it is `obol`, the record's
   `address` is this address and `provenance.factoryAddress` (when present) is the chain's OVM factory. That answer
   is then confirmed on chain (3.0.0-rc.12): with a `creationTxHash`, `eth_getTransactionReceipt` must be a
   successful transaction holding a log emitted by the chain table's factory with topic 0
   `CreateObolValidatorManager` and topic 1 = this address → `obol` / chain (one request, no log scan). A receipt
   without that log means the API is wrong → step 3. No `creationTxHash`, or the receipt could not be read: with
   `requireChain` → step 3; without it → `obol` / api (with `creationTxHash` when given), the API's `reason` marked
   "not confirmed on chain". `notObol` (which can be an answer cached before the OVM was
   deployed or indexed, while step 1 saw code), `unknown`, a record for another address or no `provenance` → step 3
   (3.0.0-rc.7). When that endpoint fails (404 while it is not deployed, or any other API error), the interim
   `GET /v1/eth/contract-creation/:network/:address`: used only when its `contractAddress` is present and equals this
   address (case-insensitive) and it names a creating factory: when that is the chain's OVM factory, `obol`, handled
   as the record's `obol` above (it has no transaction hash, so `obol` / api, or step 3 with `requireChain`); else
   `notObol` / api. A record without `contractAddress`, no record or an API error → step 3.
3. Chain, the OVM getters (`readOvmCore`, one Multicall3 read at head): read, and a required getter reverted →
   `notObol` / chain ("does not answer the OVM getters"), since every contract the factory creates answers them. A
   failed read → step 4.
4. Chain: `eth_getLogs` on the factory for `CreateObolValidatorManager(address indexed ovm, address indexed owner,
address beneficiary, address rewardRecipient, uint64 principalThreshold)` with `topic1 = ovm`, between the
   factory deployment block and head, newest range first, stopping at the first match: found → `obol` / chain with
   `creationTxHash`; none → `notObol` / chain; any failed range → `unknown` / chain. Ranges follow "Log scans" below.

Never decided `obol` by a bytecode or function-signature probe: a look-alike contract would pass. Step 3 only ever
concludes `notObol`, which a missing getter proves. "Could not check" is always `unknown`, never `notObol`.

</details>

<details class="sdk-spec">
<summary>Specification: ovm.getState</summary>

Tag: `api+chain` (money values always `chain`). Input: `ovm`. Output: `null` when the address is not an OVM (no
code, or the batch was read and the OVM getters reverted), else:

```
{ address, blockNumber: uint, owner, principalRecipient, rewardRecipient,
  amountOfPrincipalStake: bigint, fundsPendingWithdrawal: bigint, principalThreshold: bigint (wei),
  version: string?, balance: bigint, pullBalances: { principalRecipient: bigint, rewardRecipient: bigint },
  distributable: bigint, principalPayout: bigint, rewardPayout: bigint,   # what distributeFunds() would pay now
  principalOnBeaconChain: bigint | null?,                                  # API only, see below
  findings: Finding[], source }
```

Chain read: one Multicall3 `aggregate3` of `owner`, `principalRecipient`, `rewardRecipient`, `amountOfPrincipalStake`,
`fundsPendingWithdrawal`, `principalThreshold` (gwei → wei), `version` (may fail: `null`), `getEthBalance(ovm)`,
`getBlockNumber`; then `getPullBalance` of both recipients and `rolesOf` of each of the chain's public forwarders (see
"Public forwarders" below) at that block. A required getter reverting means the address is not an OVM: `null`; a read
that fails (RPC error) is [`CHAIN_READ_FAILED`](../errors.md#CHAIN_READ_FAILED), never `null`. **`getState` checks the shape of the contract, never its
origin**: a look-alike contract answers the getters, so a non-null result says nothing about provenance; that is
`verify` only. (2.16; `null` new in 3.0.0-rc.4, was [`OVM_READ_FAILED`](../errors.md#OVM_READ_FAILED)) When a public forwarder is the owner or holds a role, `findings` has [`PUBLIC_FORWARDER_HOLDS_ROLE`](../warnings.md#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_HOLDS_ROLE)
(warning) naming it and its roles: anyone can call the role-gated functions through it. (new)

`distributable`, `principalPayout` and `rewardPayout` follow `ObolValidatorManager._distributeFunds` (vectors
`distribution.json` `routing`): `distributable = balance − fundsPendingWithdrawal`; if `distributable ≥
principalThreshold` and `amountOfPrincipalStake > 0`, principal gets `min(distributable, amountOfPrincipalStake)` and
rewards the rest; otherwise rewards get everything. One call gives a page its "to distribute" figure and routing.

**`amountOfPrincipalStake` is a routing counter, not a measure of stake.** Anyone holding `DEPOSIT_ROLE` raises it
with each `OVM.deposit`, including deposits to validators with other credentials, and repeating a deposit with the
same ETH (exit, redeposit) raises it again; at distribution the excess comes out of rewards. Never use it for
incentives, TVS or "staked" figures. With the API, `principalOnBeaconChain` is the ETH the beacon chain credited to
validators with this OVM's credentials minus principal already paid out (indexed by the API); when it differs from
`amountOfPrincipalStake` by more than 1 ETH, `findings` has [`PRINCIPAL_STAKE_MISMATCH`](../warnings.md#PRINCIPAL_STAKE_MISMATCH) (warning) with both values.
`principalOnBeaconChain` is `null` when the API was asked and had no value (or failed), absent with `api: false`
(README "Null and absent").

</details>

<details class="sdk-spec">
<summary>Specification: ovm.getRoleHolders</summary>

Tag: `api+chain`. Input: `ovm`. Output: `{ owner, holders: { address, roles: uint, roleNames: string[], isOwner:
bool }[], source, blockNumber }`.

1. Candidates: the API OVM record's `roles` addresses (`GET /v1/ovm/:network/:address`, when it answers with a
   `roles` list), else `RolesUpdated(address indexed user, uint256 indexed roles)` logs of the OVM from the factory
   deployment block from the interim `GET /v1/eth/logs/:network?address&topic0&fromBlock` (used only if `status = "1"`
   and not truncated); with either, plus an RPC scan of the last 50,000 blocks. Without an API answer, a full chunked
   RPC scan; a failed full scan → [`OVM_ROLE_EVENTS_UNAVAILABLE`](../errors.md#OVM_ROLE_EVENTS_UNAVAILABLE). The chain's public forwarders are always candidates.
   `source` is `api` when an API list was used. (2.16)
2. `owner()` and `rolesOf(candidate)` in one `aggregate3` at head; `owner()` failing → [`OVM_READ_FAILED`](../errors.md#OVM_READ_FAILED).
3. The owner is always the first holder (with its roles, possibly 0); other candidates with roles 0 are dropped.
4. `findings`: [`PUBLIC_FORWARDER_HOLDS_ROLE`](../warnings.md#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_HOLDS_ROLE) (warning) when the owner or a holder is a public forwarder, naming its
   roles. (new)

Output also has `findings: Finding[]`. Roles shown come from `rolesOf`, never from the API or the events alone.

### ovm.prepareWithdraw {#prepareWithdraw}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">chain</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--throws">throws 16</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">3 warnings</span> <a class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--stage" href="../lifecycle#exit">7. Exit, withdraw, consolidate</a></div>

EIP-7002 withdrawal requests through the OVM: a partial amount, or 0 for a full exit
(needs `acknowledgeFullExit: true`). Checks provenance, the WITHDRAWAL role, the fee and,
with a status source, every beacon chain rule that would make the chain ignore the
request and keep the fee (VALIDATOR_NOT_ACTIVE, CREDENTIALS_NOT_SOURCE, VALIDATOR_EXITING,
VALIDATOR_TOO_NEW, ...). Rules it could not check: VALIDATOR_STATUS_UNCHECKED (warning).

```ts sdk-signature
obol.ovm.prepareWithdraw(
  input: PrepareWithdrawInput,
): Promise<Prepared<'withdraw'>>
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>input</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/ovm#PrepareWithdrawInput">PrepareWithdrawInput</a></span> |  |

```ts

import { parseEther } from 'viem';

const withdraw = await obol.ovm.prepareWithdraw({
  ovm: ovmAddress,
```

<details class="sdk-spec">
<summary>Specification: ovm.prepareWithdraw</summary>

Tag: `chain`. Inputs: `{ ovm: Address, requests: { pubkey: Pubkey, amount: bigint }[], fee: bigint?,
excessFeeRecipient: Address?, from: Address?, acknowledgeFullExit: true?, beaconUrl: string?, lockHash: Hash32? }`.
`amount = 0` is a full exit (EIP-7002).

Checks:

1. At least one request; each `amount` whole gwei and ≤ 2^64−1 gwei ([`PAYLOAD_INVALID`](../errors.md#PAYLOAD_INVALID)). (2.15 schema; units new)
   Any `amount = 0` requires `acknowledgeFullExit: true`, else [`FULL_EXIT_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED`](../errors.md#FULL_EXIT_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED): an exit is
   irreversible and takes the validator offline, and 0 is too easy to pass by accident. (new)
2. `excessFeeRecipient` (default: `from`, else the wallet account) is non-zero. (2.15)
3. [`ovm.getProvenance`](./ovm.md#getProvenance): `notObol` → [`OVM_NOT_OBOL`](../errors.md#OVM_NOT_OBOL); `unknown` → Finding [`PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN`](../errors.md#PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN) (warning). (new)
4. Sender is owner or holds `WITHDRAWAL` ([`OVM_ROLE_MISSING`](../errors.md#OVM_ROLE_MISSING)). (new)
5. Fee: read the EIP-7002 fee (`eth_call` to `0x00000961Ef480Eb55e80D19ad83579A64c007002` with empty data; empty or
   failed → [`FEE_READ_FAILED`](../errors.md#FEE_READ_FAILED)), then resolve the total. The accepted range is `[fee × n, max(10 × fee, 1 gwei) × n]`; a
   given `fee` outside it → [`FEE_OUT_OF_RANGE`](../errors.md#FEE_OUT_OF_RANGE). The default is the top of the range, `max(10 × fee, 1 gwei) × n`: the
   OVM forwards the current fee per request to the predeploy and refunds the rest to `excessFeeRecipient`, so the
   headroom costs nothing and keeps the transaction valid if the fee rises before it is mined. Vectors
   `request_fees.json` (`default: "cap"`). (2.15 range; default changed in 3.0.0-rc.3, was `2 × fee × n`)
6. The beacon chain's rules (Electra `process_withdrawal_request`), per request in order, from [`deposits.status`](./deposits.md#status)
   ([`StatusSource`](./types/core.md#StatusSource)): a request that breaks one is ignored and its fee kept, so each is an error (new in 3.0.0-rc.4;
   rc.3 warned for three of them):
   1. in the registry and active, else [`VALIDATOR_NOT_ACTIVE`](../errors.md#VALIDATOR_NOT_ACTIVE);
   2. credentials `0x01` / `0x02` of the OVM, else [`CREDENTIALS_NOT_SOURCE`](../errors.md#CREDENTIALS_NOT_SOURCE);
   3. no exit initiated (`exitEpoch` null; else the beacon status), else [`VALIDATOR_EXITING`](../errors.md#VALIDATOR_EXITING);
   4. current epoch ≥ `activationEpoch + 256` (`SHARD_COMMITTEE_PERIOD`; the current epoch from the chain's genesis
      time, mainnet 1606824023, Hoodi 1742213400, 12 s slots, 32 slots per epoch, no request), else
      [`VALIDATOR_TOO_NEW`](../errors.md#VALIDATOR_TOO_NEW);
   5. a full exit: no pending partial withdrawals (`pendingPartialWithdrawals`, plus partials earlier in this
      request list), else [`EXIT_BLOCKED_BY_PENDING_WITHDRAWAL`](../errors.md#EXIT_BLOCKED_BY_PENDING_WITHDRAWAL);
   6. a partial: `0x02` credentials ([`PARTIAL_REQUIRES_COMPOUNDING`](../errors.md#PARTIAL_REQUIRES_COMPOUNDING)), `effectiveBalance` ≥ 32 ETH
      ([`EFFECTIVE_BALANCE_TOO_LOW`](../errors.md#EFFECTIVE_BALANCE_TOO_LOW)), `balance` > 32 ETH + pending ([`NO_EXCESS_BALANCE`](../errors.md#NO_EXCESS_BALANCE)); the amount is capped to
      `balance − 32 ETH − pending` (whole gwei), sent capped, with Finding [`WITHDRAW_AMOUNT_CAPPED`](../warnings.md#WITHDRAW_AMOUNT_CAPPED) (info) and
      `requestedAmount` in the preview; an excess under 1 gwei, which would cap the amount to 0 (a full exit under
      EIP-7002), is [`NO_EXCESS_BALANCE`](../errors.md#NO_EXCESS_BALANCE) too, so a partial request is never sent with amount 0; a full pending partial withdrawal queue (known only from a beacon node) →
      Finding [`PARTIAL_WITHDRAWAL_QUEUE_FULL`](../warnings.md#PARTIAL_WITHDRAWAL_QUEUE_FULL) (warning).

   Without a status source: Finding [`VALIDATOR_STATUS_UNCHECKED`](../warnings.md#VALIDATOR_STATUS_UNCHECKED) (warning since 3.0.0-rc.12, `checks: ["all"]`). A rule whose data the
   source did not give (an API answer without the epochs or pending partials) is skipped with
   [`VALIDATOR_STATUS_UNCHECKED`](../warnings.md#VALIDATOR_STATUS_UNCHECKED) naming it, for that validator.
   Output: `Prepared<"withdraw">`, preview `{ requests: { pubkey, amount, requestedAmount?, routedAs?, principalPart?,
rewardPart? }[], totalFee: bigint, maxFeePerRequest: bigint }` with
   `OVM.withdraw(pubKeys, amounts_gwei, maxFeePerWithdrawal = floor(totalFee / n), excessFeeRecipient)`,
   `value = totalFee`. The contract requires `value ≥ maxFeePerWithdrawal × n` and `currentFee ≤ maxFeePerWithdrawal`.

`routedAs` (`"principal" | "reward" | "mixed"`) says how a distribution right after this request's ETH arrives would
route it, if nothing else arrives: the routing above applied to `distributable + amount` (for a full exit, `amount` is
the validator's balance from [`deposits.status`](./deposits.md#status), else `routedAs` is absent). With the default 16 ETH threshold, a
withdrawal of 16 ETH or more is paid as principal while `amountOfPrincipalStake` lasts.

</details>

<p class="sdk-see">See also: <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/operations.md#ovmpreparewithdraw">spec/operations.md</a> · <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/schemas/ovm.prepareWithdraw.json">input JSON Schema</a> · <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/src/ovm/index.ts#L186">source</a></p>

### ovm.prepareConsolidate {#prepareConsolidate}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">chain</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--throws">throws 14</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">3 warnings</span> <a class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--stage" href="../lifecycle#exit">7. Exit, withdraw, consolidate</a></div>

EIP-7251 consolidation requests through the OVM. A source equal to its target switches
that validator to 0x02 (compounding). A target with another withdrawal address is
allowed by the chain but moves the stake out of this OVM: CONSOLIDATION_CREDENTIALS_DIFFER
(warning), which `send` asks to be acknowledged.

<details class="sdk-spec">
<summary>Specification: ovm.prepareConsolidate</summary>

Tag: `chain`. Inputs: `{ ovm, requests: { sources: Pubkey[], target: Pubkey }[], fee: bigint?, excessFeeRecipient:
Address?, from: Address?, beaconUrl: string?, lockHash: Hash32? }`. A source equal to its target switches that
validator to `0x02` (compounding) credentials.

Checks:

1. There is no acknowledgement flag on the input (3.0.0-rc.12 removed `acknowledgeStakeMovesToTarget` and
   `CONSOLIDATION_NOT_ACKNOWLEDGED`: the flag had to be `true` on every call, also for a switch to compounding that
   moves nothing, so it protected nothing; passing it is now [`PAYLOAD_INVALID`](../errors.md#PAYLOAD_INVALID), `unknown_key`). What needs
   acknowledging is reported as a warning in step 5 and enforced by `send`.
2. Each request has 1–63 sources (contract limit; else it reverts) ([`PAYLOAD_INVALID`](../errors.md#PAYLOAD_INVALID)). (new, from contract)
3. Provenance and role (`CONSOLIDATION`) as `prepareWithdraw` 3–4.
4. Fee as `prepareWithdraw` 5 with the EIP-7251 predeploy `0x0000BBdDc7CE488642fb579F8B00f3a590007251` and
   n = total sources; read failure [`FEE_READ_FAILED`](../errors.md#FEE_READ_FAILED). (2.16)
5. The beacon chain's rules (Electra `process_consolidation_request`), per source, from the status source; each is an
   error (new in 3.0.0-rc.4): the source in the registry and active ([`VALIDATOR_NOT_ACTIVE`](../errors.md#VALIDATOR_NOT_ACTIVE)) with credentials of the
   OVM ([`CREDENTIALS_NOT_SOURCE`](../errors.md#CREDENTIALS_NOT_SOURCE)). Source = target (switch to compounding): `0x01` credentials, else
   [`CONSOLIDATION_ALREADY_COMPOUNDING`](../errors.md#CONSOLIDATION_ALREADY_COMPOUNDING), and not exiting ([`VALIDATOR_EXITING`](../errors.md#VALIDATOR_EXITING)). Source ≠ target: target `0x02`
   ([`CONSOLIDATION_TARGET_NOT_COMPOUNDING`](../errors.md#CONSOLIDATION_TARGET_NOT_COMPOUNDING)), target active ([`VALIDATOR_NOT_ACTIVE`](../errors.md#VALIDATOR_NOT_ACTIVE)), neither exiting
   ([`VALIDATOR_EXITING`](../errors.md#VALIDATOR_EXITING)), source past the shard committee period ([`VALIDATOR_TOO_NEW`](../errors.md#VALIDATOR_TOO_NEW)), source without pending partial
   withdrawals ([`CONSOLIDATION_BLOCKED_BY_PENDING_WITHDRAWAL`](../errors.md#CONSOLIDATION_BLOCKED_BY_PENDING_WITHDRAWAL)). A target of another withdrawal address is allowed by the
   chain (the stake leaves this OVM and cannot be moved back): Finding [`CONSOLIDATION_CREDENTIALS_DIFFER`](../warnings.md#CONSOLIDATION_CREDENTIALS_DIFFER) (warning,
   per source, with both withdrawal addresses), which `send` refuses until acknowledged. Unchecked rules as
   `prepareWithdraw` 6: [`VALIDATOR_STATUS_UNCHECKED`](../warnings.md#VALIDATOR_STATUS_UNCHECKED) (warning), also when there is no status source at all or the
   target's credentials are unknown, since the withdrawal addresses were then not compared.

Output: `Prepared<"consolidate">` with `OVM.consolidate((srcPubKeys, targetPubKey)[], maxFeePerConsolidation =
floor(totalFee / n), excessFeeRecipient)`, `value = totalFee`.

</details>

### ovm.prepareDistribute {#prepareDistribute}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">chain</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--throws">throws 4</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">1 warning</span> <a class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--stage" href="../lifecycle#distribute">8. Distribute and claim</a></div>

Distributes the OVM's balance to its principal and reward recipients (`distributeFunds`,
or `distributeFundsPull` with `mode: 'pull'`). Anyone may send it. Nothing to pay:
NOTHING_TO_DISTRIBUTE. To also distribute the splits behind the recipients use
[`splits.prepareDistributeAll`](./splits.md#prepareDistributeAll).

```ts sdk-signature
obol.ovm.prepareDistribute(
  input: PrepareDistributeInput,
): Promise<Prepared<'distribute'>>
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>input</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/ovm#PrepareDistributeInput">PrepareDistributeInput</a></span> |  |
| <code>input.ovm</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |
| <code>input.mode?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">'push' &#124; 'pull'</span> | `push` (default): distributeFunds(); `pull`: distributeFundsPull(). |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">Promise&lt;<a href="./types/send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'distribute'&gt;&gt;</span>: a `Prepared` of kind `'distribute'`, preview <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/send#PreviewByKind">PreviewByKind</a>['distribute']</span>. Send it with [`obol.send`](./send.md#send) or your wallet layer.

**Throws** <span class="sdk-muted">(per spec)</span> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#CHAIN_READ_FAILED">CHAIN_READ_FAILED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_NOT_OBOL">OVM_NOT_OBOL</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_READ_FAILED">OVM_READ_FAILED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#NOTHING_TO_DISTRIBUTE">NOTHING_TO_DISTRIBUTE</a> <span class="sdk-muted">plus the [checks every operation runs](../errors.md#checks-every-operation-runs)</span>

**Can report** <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--warning" href="../warnings#PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN" title="warning">PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN</a>

**Example**

```ts
const distribute = await obol.ovm.prepareDistribute({ ovm: ovmAddress }); // NOTHING_TO_DISTRIBUTE if empty
await (await obol.send(distribute)).wait();
```

<details class="sdk-spec">
<summary>Specification: ovm.prepareDistribute</summary>

Tag: `chain`. Inputs: `{ ovm, mode: "push" | "pull" (default "push") }`. Calls `distributeFunds()` or
`distributeFundsPull()` (anyone may call).

1. Provenance as `prepareWithdraw` 3.
2. Read state on-chain (`getState`); `distributable = 0` → [`NOTHING_TO_DISTRIBUTE`](../errors.md#NOTHING_TO_DISTRIBUTE).

Preview: the routing of `distribution.json` `routing` (`distributable`, `principalPayout`, `rewardPayout`) with the
recipients. Use [`splits.prepareDistributeAll`](./splits.md#prepareDistributeAll) to also distribute the splits behind the recipients.

[`ovm.previewDistribute(input)`](./ovm.md#previewDistribute) (`chain`) runs the same reads and returns `PreviewResult<DistributePreview>` (`{
preview, checks, blockNumber }`, the shape of every `preview*`) without throwing for `NOTHING_TO_DISTRIBUTE` (zeros
instead), so a page can show the figures with the button disabled. It is not a [`Prepared`](./types/send.md#Prepared), so it cannot be sent by
mistake.

### ovm.prepareGrantRoles {#prepareGrantRoles}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">chain</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--throws">throws 6</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">3 warnings</span> <a class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--stage" href="../lifecycle#operate">6. Operate</a></div>

Grants `roles` to `user` (`grantRoles`); owner only. Reports ROLE_GRANT_CONSOLIDATION
and ROLE_GRANT_DEPOSIT_TO_PRINCIPAL (warnings) for the grants that can move the stake.

```ts sdk-signature
obol.ovm.prepareGrantRoles(
  input: GrantRolesInput,
): Promise<Prepared<'role'>>
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>input</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/ovm#GrantRolesInput">GrantRolesInput</a></span> |  |
| <code>input.ovm</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |
| <code>input.user</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |
| <code>input.roles</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint &#124; number</span> | A non-zero combination of OVM_ROLES. |
| <code>input.from?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">Promise&lt;<a href="./types/send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'role'&gt;&gt;</span>: a `Prepared` of kind `'role'`, preview <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/send#PreviewByKind">PreviewByKind</a>['role']</span>. Send it with [`obol.send`](./send.md#send) or your wallet layer.

**Throws** <span class="sdk-muted">(per spec)</span> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#CHAIN_READ_FAILED">CHAIN_READ_FAILED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_NOT_OBOL">OVM_NOT_OBOL</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_READ_FAILED">OVM_READ_FAILED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_ROLE_MISSING">OVM_ROLE_MISSING</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_OWNER_REQUIRED">OVM_OWNER_REQUIRED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_ROLE_HOLDER">PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_ROLE_HOLDER</a> <span class="sdk-muted">plus the [checks every operation runs](../errors.md#checks-every-operation-runs)</span>

**Can report** <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--warning" href="../warnings#PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN" title="warning">PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--warning" href="../warnings#ROLE_GRANT_CONSOLIDATION" title="warning">ROLE_GRANT_CONSOLIDATION</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--warning" href="../warnings#ROLE_GRANT_DEPOSIT_TO_PRINCIPAL" title="warning">ROLE_GRANT_DEPOSIT_TO_PRINCIPAL</a>

**Example**

```ts
const grant = await obol.ovm.prepareGrantRoles({
  ovm: ovmAddress,
  user: account,
  roles: obol.ovm.OVM_ROLES.WITHDRAWAL | obol.ovm.OVM_ROLES.CONSOLIDATION, // CONSOLIDATION carries a warning
});
```

<details class="sdk-spec">
<summary>Specification: ovm role and ownership writes (shared section)</summary>

Tag: `chain`. Thin wrappers; each returns a [`Prepared`](./types/send.md#Prepared) (kinds `role`, `ownership`, `recipient`, `principalStake`,
`sweep`, `withdrawPullBalance`, `recoverFunds`; preview `{ function, args }`) calling the OVM function in the table.
Input and preview names follow the SDK's state names (`principalRecipient`), with the contract's "beneficiary" only in
the function names. The role bits keep the contract's constant names (`SET_BENEFICIARY`).
Shared checks, in order: the input checks of the table (the public forwarder checks need no chain read); `ovm`
provenance as `prepareWithdraw` 3; the sender's authority as below ([`OVM_ROLE_MISSING`](../errors.md#OVM_ROLE_MISSING) / [`OVM_OWNER_REQUIRED`](../errors.md#OVM_OWNER_REQUIRED)), read
on-chain. (2.16 wrappers; authority and forwarder checks new)

<div class="sdk-table">

| Operation                          | Contract call                                                                                      | Authority                      | Input checks                                                                                                                                                              |
| ---------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `prepareGrantRoles`                | `grantRoles(user, roles)`                                                                          | owner                          | `user` non-zero and not a public forwarder ([`PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_ROLE_HOLDER`](../errors.md#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_ROLE_HOLDER)); `roles` non-zero subset of `OVM_ROLES`                                                    |
| `prepareRevokeRoles`               | `revokeRoles(user, roles)`                                                                         | owner                          | same                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `prepareRenounceRoles`             | `renounceRoles(roles)`                                                                             | sender holds them              | `roles` as above                                                                                                                                                          |
| `prepareRequestOwnershipHandover`  | `requestOwnershipHandover()`                                                                       | anyone (the new owner)         | –                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `prepareCancelOwnershipHandover`   | `cancelOwnershipHandover()`                                                                        | requester                      | –                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `prepareCompleteOwnershipHandover` | `completeOwnershipHandover(pendingOwner)`                                                          | owner                          | `pendingOwner` non-zero and not a public forwarder ([`PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER`](../errors.md#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER)); `ownershipHandoverExpiresAt(pendingOwner)` > now, else [`OWNERSHIP_HANDOVER_NOT_PENDING`](../errors.md#OWNERSHIP_HANDOVER_NOT_PENDING) |
| `prepareTransfer`                  | `transfer(newPrincipalRecipient, newOwner)` (the contract's `beneficiary`)                         | owner                          | both non-zero; `newOwner` not a public forwarder ([`PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER`](../errors.md#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER))                                                                                            |
| `prepareSetPrincipalRecipient`     | `setBeneficiary(newPrincipalRecipient)` (the contract calls the principal recipient "beneficiary") | owner or `SET_BENEFICIARY`     | non-zero                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `prepareSetRewardRecipient`        | `setRewardRecipient(newRewardRecipient)`                                                           | owner or `SET_REWARD`          | non-zero                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `prepareSetAmountOfPrincipalStake` | `setAmountOfPrincipalStake(amount)`                                                                | owner or `SET_BENEFICIARY`     | `amount` uint256 wei                                                                                                                                                      |
| `prepareSweep`                     | `sweep(to, amount)` (the contract's `beneficiary` argument)                                        | anyone; owner when `to` is set | `amount` ≤ principal recipient's pull balance (0 = all); `to` default zero (= principal recipient)                                                                        |
| `prepareWithdrawPullBalance`       | `withdrawPullBalance(account)`                                                                     | anyone                         | `account` non-zero; pull balance 0 → [`NOTHING_TO_DISTRIBUTE`](../errors.md#NOTHING_TO_DISTRIBUTE)                                                                                                              |
| `prepareRecoverFunds`              | `recoverFunds(token, recipient)`                                                                   | owner or `RECOVER_FUNDS`       | both non-zero                                                                                                                                                             |

</div>

Previews and findings on these writes:

- `prepareSetAmountOfPrincipalStake`: preview `{ current, next, delta }` (wei, `delta` signed): raising it by 32 ETH
  means reward recipients get 32 ETH less at the next distribution.
- `prepareTransfer` and `prepareCompleteOwnershipHandover`: Finding [`ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER`](../warnings.md#ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER) (warning) listing the
  current non-owner role holders ([`ovm.getRoleHolders`](./ovm.md#getRoleHolders)), since a transfer does not revoke roles. Absent when there are
  none; if the holders cannot be read, Finding [`ROLE_HOLDERS_UNCHECKED`](../warnings.md#ROLE_HOLDERS_UNCHECKED) (info).
- `prepareGrantRoles`: Finding [`ROLE_GRANT_CONSOLIDATION`](../warnings.md#ROLE_GRANT_CONSOLIDATION) (warning) when `roles` includes `CONSOLIDATION` (the holder
  can consolidate every validator into one it controls, moving the whole stake); Finding
  [`ROLE_GRANT_DEPOSIT_TO_PRINCIPAL`](../warnings.md#ROLE_GRANT_DEPOSIT_TO_PRINCIPAL) (warning) when `roles` includes `DEPOSIT` and `user` is the principal recipient
  (it can raise `amountOfPrincipalStake` and take rewards as principal; see `getState`).

`transferOwnership` and `renounceOwnership` are not wrapped: `transfer` and the two-step handover cover the use, and
renouncing leaves an OVM without an owner. (2.16 did not wrap them either.)

<p class="sdk-muted">From <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/operations.md">spec/operations.md</a>.</p>

</details>

<p class="sdk-see">See also: <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/operations.md#ovm-role-and-ownership-writes">spec/operations.md</a> · <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/schemas/ovm.prepareGrantRoles.json">input JSON Schema</a> · <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/src/ovm/index.ts#L226">source</a></p>

```ts
const renounce = await obol.ovm.prepareRenounceRoles({ ovm: ovmAddress, roles: obol.ovm.OVM_ROLES.WITHDRAWAL });
```

<details class="sdk-spec">
<summary>Specification: ovm role and ownership writes (shared section)</summary>

Tag: `chain`. Thin wrappers; each returns a [`Prepared`](./types/send.md#Prepared) (kinds `role`, `ownership`, `recipient`, `principalStake`,
`sweep`, `withdrawPullBalance`, `recoverFunds`; preview `{ function, args }`) calling the OVM function in the table.
Input and preview names follow the SDK's state names (`principalRecipient`), with the contract's "beneficiary" only in
the function names. The role bits keep the contract's constant names (`SET_BENEFICIARY`).
Shared checks, in order: the input checks of the table (the public forwarder checks need no chain read); `ovm`
provenance as `prepareWithdraw` 3; the sender's authority as below ([`OVM_ROLE_MISSING`](../errors.md#OVM_ROLE_MISSING) / [`OVM_OWNER_REQUIRED`](../errors.md#OVM_OWNER_REQUIRED)), read
on-chain. (2.16 wrappers; authority and forwarder checks new)

<div class="sdk-table">

| Operation                          | Contract call                                                                                      | Authority                      | Input checks                                                                                                                                                              |
| ---------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `prepareGrantRoles`                | `grantRoles(user, roles)`                                                                          | owner                          | `user` non-zero and not a public forwarder ([`PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_ROLE_HOLDER`](../errors.md#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_ROLE_HOLDER)); `roles` non-zero subset of `OVM_ROLES`                                                    |
| `prepareRevokeRoles`               | `revokeRoles(user, roles)`                                                                         | owner                          | same                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `prepareRenounceRoles`             | `renounceRoles(roles)`                                                                             | sender holds them              | `roles` as above                                                                                                                                                          |
| `prepareRequestOwnershipHandover`  | `requestOwnershipHandover()`                                                                       | anyone (the new owner)         | –                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `prepareCancelOwnershipHandover`   | `cancelOwnershipHandover()`                                                                        | requester                      | –                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `prepareCompleteOwnershipHandover` | `completeOwnershipHandover(pendingOwner)`                                                          | owner                          | `pendingOwner` non-zero and not a public forwarder ([`PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER`](../errors.md#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER)); `ownershipHandoverExpiresAt(pendingOwner)` > now, else [`OWNERSHIP_HANDOVER_NOT_PENDING`](../errors.md#OWNERSHIP_HANDOVER_NOT_PENDING) |
| `prepareTransfer`                  | `transfer(newPrincipalRecipient, newOwner)` (the contract's `beneficiary`)                         | owner                          | both non-zero; `newOwner` not a public forwarder ([`PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER`](../errors.md#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER))                                                                                            |
| `prepareSetPrincipalRecipient`     | `setBeneficiary(newPrincipalRecipient)` (the contract calls the principal recipient "beneficiary") | owner or `SET_BENEFICIARY`     | non-zero                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `prepareSetRewardRecipient`        | `setRewardRecipient(newRewardRecipient)`                                                           | owner or `SET_REWARD`          | non-zero                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `prepareSetAmountOfPrincipalStake` | `setAmountOfPrincipalStake(amount)`                                                                | owner or `SET_BENEFICIARY`     | `amount` uint256 wei                                                                                                                                                      |
| `prepareSweep`                     | `sweep(to, amount)` (the contract's `beneficiary` argument)                                        | anyone; owner when `to` is set | `amount` ≤ principal recipient's pull balance (0 = all); `to` default zero (= principal recipient)                                                                        |
| `prepareWithdrawPullBalance`       | `withdrawPullBalance(account)`                                                                     | anyone                         | `account` non-zero; pull balance 0 → [`NOTHING_TO_DISTRIBUTE`](../errors.md#NOTHING_TO_DISTRIBUTE)                                                                                                              |
| `prepareRecoverFunds`              | `recoverFunds(token, recipient)`                                                                   | owner or `RECOVER_FUNDS`       | both non-zero                                                                                                                                                             |

</div>

Previews and findings on these writes:

- `prepareSetAmountOfPrincipalStake`: preview `{ current, next, delta }` (wei, `delta` signed): raising it by 32 ETH
  means reward recipients get 32 ETH less at the next distribution.
- `prepareTransfer` and `prepareCompleteOwnershipHandover`: Finding [`ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER`](../warnings.md#ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER) (warning) listing the
  current non-owner role holders ([`ovm.getRoleHolders`](./ovm.md#getRoleHolders)), since a transfer does not revoke roles. Absent when there are
  none; if the holders cannot be read, Finding [`ROLE_HOLDERS_UNCHECKED`](../warnings.md#ROLE_HOLDERS_UNCHECKED) (info).
- `prepareGrantRoles`: Finding [`ROLE_GRANT_CONSOLIDATION`](../warnings.md#ROLE_GRANT_CONSOLIDATION) (warning) when `roles` includes `CONSOLIDATION` (the holder
  can consolidate every validator into one it controls, moving the whole stake); Finding
  [`ROLE_GRANT_DEPOSIT_TO_PRINCIPAL`](../warnings.md#ROLE_GRANT_DEPOSIT_TO_PRINCIPAL) (warning) when `roles` includes `DEPOSIT` and `user` is the principal recipient
  (it can raise `amountOfPrincipalStake` and take rewards as principal; see `getState`).

`transferOwnership` and `renounceOwnership` are not wrapped: `transfer` and the two-step handover cover the use, and
renouncing leaves an OVM without an owner. (2.16 did not wrap them either.)

</details>

<p class="sdk-see">See also: <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/operations.md#ovm-role-and-ownership-writes">spec/operations.md</a> · <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/schemas/ovm.prepareRenounceRoles.json">input JSON Schema</a> · <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/src/ovm/index.ts#L238">source</a></p>

### ovm.prepareTransfer {#prepareTransfer}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">chain</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--throws">throws 5</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">2 warnings</span> <a class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--stage" href="../lifecycle#operate">6. Operate</a></div>

Sets a new owner and principal recipient in one call (`transfer`); owner only. Roles
survive (ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER).

```ts sdk-signature
obol.ovm.prepareTransfer(
  input: TransferInput,
): Promise<Prepared<'ownership'>>
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>input</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/ovm#TransferInput">TransferInput</a></span> |  |
| <code>input.ovm</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |
| <code>input.newPrincipalRecipient</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> | The new principal recipient (the contract's "beneficiary"). |
| <code>input.newOwner</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |
| <code>input.from?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">Promise&lt;<a href="./types/send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'ownership'&gt;&gt;</span>: a `Prepared` of kind `'ownership'`, preview <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/send#PreviewByKind">PreviewByKind</a>['ownership']</span>. Send it with [`obol.send`](./send.md#send) or your wallet layer.

**Throws** <span class="sdk-muted">(per spec)</span> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#CHAIN_READ_FAILED">CHAIN_READ_FAILED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_NOT_OBOL">OVM_NOT_OBOL</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_READ_FAILED">OVM_READ_FAILED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_OWNER_REQUIRED">OVM_OWNER_REQUIRED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER">PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER</a> <span class="sdk-muted">plus the [checks every operation runs](../errors.md#checks-every-operation-runs)</span>

**Can report** <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--warning" href="../warnings#PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN" title="warning">PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--warning" href="../warnings#ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER" title="warning">ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--info" href="../warnings#ROLE_HOLDERS_UNCHECKED" title="info">ROLE_HOLDERS_UNCHECKED</a>

**Example**

```ts
// Changes owner and principal recipient together; roles survive (ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER).
const transfer = await obol.ovm.prepareTransfer({ ovm: ovmAddress, newOwner: account, newPrincipalRecipient: account });
```

### ovm.prepareCancelOwnershipHandover {#prepareCancelOwnershipHandover}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">chain</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--throws">throws 3</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">2 warnings</span></div>

Cancels the sender's pending ownership request (`cancelOwnershipHandover`).

```ts sdk-signature
obol.ovm.prepareCancelOwnershipHandover(
  input: OvmOnlyInput,
): Promise<Prepared<'ownership'>>
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>input</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/ovm#OvmOnlyInput">OvmOnlyInput</a></span> |  |
| <code>input.ovm</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |
| <code>input.from?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">Promise&lt;<a href="./types/send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'ownership'&gt;&gt;</span>: a `Prepared` of kind `'ownership'`, preview <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/send#PreviewByKind">PreviewByKind</a>['ownership']</span>. Send it with [`obol.send`](./send.md#send) or your wallet layer.

**Throws** <span class="sdk-muted">(per spec)</span> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#CHAIN_READ_FAILED">CHAIN_READ_FAILED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_NOT_OBOL">OVM_NOT_OBOL</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_READ_FAILED">OVM_READ_FAILED</a> <span class="sdk-muted">plus the [checks every operation runs](../errors.md#checks-every-operation-runs)</span>

**Can report** <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--warning" href="../warnings#PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN" title="warning">PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--warning" href="../warnings#ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER" title="warning">ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--info" href="../warnings#ROLE_HOLDERS_UNCHECKED" title="info">ROLE_HOLDERS_UNCHECKED</a>

**Example**

```ts
const cancel = await obol.ovm.prepareCancelOwnershipHandover({ ovm: ovmAddress });
```

<details class="sdk-spec">
<summary>Specification: ovm role and ownership writes (shared section)</summary>

Tag: `chain`. Thin wrappers; each returns a [`Prepared`](./types/send.md#Prepared) (kinds `role`, `ownership`, `recipient`, `principalStake`,
`sweep`, `withdrawPullBalance`, `recoverFunds`; preview `{ function, args }`) calling the OVM function in the table.
Input and preview names follow the SDK's state names (`principalRecipient`), with the contract's "beneficiary" only in
the function names. The role bits keep the contract's constant names (`SET_BENEFICIARY`).
Shared checks, in order: the input checks of the table (the public forwarder checks need no chain read); `ovm`
provenance as `prepareWithdraw` 3; the sender's authority as below ([`OVM_ROLE_MISSING`](../errors.md#OVM_ROLE_MISSING) / [`OVM_OWNER_REQUIRED`](../errors.md#OVM_OWNER_REQUIRED)), read
on-chain. (2.16 wrappers; authority and forwarder checks new)

<div class="sdk-table">

| Operation                          | Contract call                                                                                      | Authority                      | Input checks                                                                                                                                                              |
| ---------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `prepareGrantRoles`                | `grantRoles(user, roles)`                                                                          | owner                          | `user` non-zero and not a public forwarder ([`PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_ROLE_HOLDER`](../errors.md#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_ROLE_HOLDER)); `roles` non-zero subset of `OVM_ROLES`                                                    |
| `prepareRevokeRoles`               | `revokeRoles(user, roles)`                                                                         | owner                          | same                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `prepareRenounceRoles`             | `renounceRoles(roles)`                                                                             | sender holds them              | `roles` as above                                                                                                                                                          |
| `prepareRequestOwnershipHandover`  | `requestOwnershipHandover()`                                                                       | anyone (the new owner)         | –                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `prepareCancelOwnershipHandover`   | `cancelOwnershipHandover()`                                                                        | requester                      | –                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `prepareCompleteOwnershipHandover` | `completeOwnershipHandover(pendingOwner)`                                                          | owner                          | `pendingOwner` non-zero and not a public forwarder ([`PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER`](../errors.md#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER)); `ownershipHandoverExpiresAt(pendingOwner)` > now, else [`OWNERSHIP_HANDOVER_NOT_PENDING`](../errors.md#OWNERSHIP_HANDOVER_NOT_PENDING) |
| `prepareTransfer`                  | `transfer(newPrincipalRecipient, newOwner)` (the contract's `beneficiary`)                         | owner                          | both non-zero; `newOwner` not a public forwarder ([`PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER`](../errors.md#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER))                                                                                            |
| `prepareSetPrincipalRecipient`     | `setBeneficiary(newPrincipalRecipient)` (the contract calls the principal recipient "beneficiary") | owner or `SET_BENEFICIARY`     | non-zero                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `prepareSetRewardRecipient`        | `setRewardRecipient(newRewardRecipient)`                                                           | owner or `SET_REWARD`          | non-zero                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `prepareSetAmountOfPrincipalStake` | `setAmountOfPrincipalStake(amount)`                                                                | owner or `SET_BENEFICIARY`     | `amount` uint256 wei                                                                                                                                                      |
| `prepareSweep`                     | `sweep(to, amount)` (the contract's `beneficiary` argument)                                        | anyone; owner when `to` is set | `amount` ≤ principal recipient's pull balance (0 = all); `to` default zero (= principal recipient)                                                                        |
| `prepareWithdrawPullBalance`       | `withdrawPullBalance(account)`                                                                     | anyone                         | `account` non-zero; pull balance 0 → [`NOTHING_TO_DISTRIBUTE`](../errors.md#NOTHING_TO_DISTRIBUTE)                                                                                                              |
| `prepareRecoverFunds`              | `recoverFunds(token, recipient)`                                                                   | owner or `RECOVER_FUNDS`       | both non-zero                                                                                                                                                             |

</div>

Previews and findings on these writes:

- `prepareSetAmountOfPrincipalStake`: preview `{ current, next, delta }` (wei, `delta` signed): raising it by 32 ETH
  means reward recipients get 32 ETH less at the next distribution.
- `prepareTransfer` and `prepareCompleteOwnershipHandover`: Finding [`ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER`](../warnings.md#ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER) (warning) listing the
  current non-owner role holders ([`ovm.getRoleHolders`](./ovm.md#getRoleHolders)), since a transfer does not revoke roles. Absent when there are
  none; if the holders cannot be read, Finding [`ROLE_HOLDERS_UNCHECKED`](../warnings.md#ROLE_HOLDERS_UNCHECKED) (info).
- `prepareGrantRoles`: Finding [`ROLE_GRANT_CONSOLIDATION`](../warnings.md#ROLE_GRANT_CONSOLIDATION) (warning) when `roles` includes `CONSOLIDATION` (the holder
  can consolidate every validator into one it controls, moving the whole stake); Finding
  [`ROLE_GRANT_DEPOSIT_TO_PRINCIPAL`](../warnings.md#ROLE_GRANT_DEPOSIT_TO_PRINCIPAL) (warning) when `roles` includes `DEPOSIT` and `user` is the principal recipient
  (it can raise `amountOfPrincipalStake` and take rewards as principal; see `getState`).

`transferOwnership` and `renounceOwnership` are not wrapped: `transfer` and the two-step handover cover the use, and
renouncing leaves an OVM without an owner. (2.16 did not wrap them either.)

<p class="sdk-muted">From <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/operations.md">spec/operations.md</a>.</p>

</details>

<p class="sdk-see">See also: <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/operations.md#ovm-role-and-ownership-writes">spec/operations.md</a> · <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/schemas/ovm.prepareCancelOwnershipHandover.json">input JSON Schema</a> · <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/src/ovm/index.ts#L255">source</a></p>

### ovm.prepareCompleteOwnershipHandover {#prepareCompleteOwnershipHandover}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">chain</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--throws">throws 6</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">2 warnings</span></div>

Hands ownership to `pendingOwner` after its request (`completeOwnershipHandover`);
owner only. OWNERSHIP_HANDOVER_NOT_PENDING without an unexpired request; roles survive
(ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER).

```ts sdk-signature
obol.ovm.prepareCompleteOwnershipHandover(
```

| <code>input.ovm</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |
| <code>input.pendingOwner</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |
| <code>input.from?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">Promise&lt;<a href="./types/send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'ownership'&gt;&gt;</span>: a `Prepared` of kind `'ownership'`, preview <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/send#PreviewByKind">PreviewByKind</a>['ownership']</span>. Send it with [`obol.send`](./send.md#send) or your wallet layer.

**Throws** <span class="sdk-muted">(per spec)</span> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#CHAIN_READ_FAILED">CHAIN_READ_FAILED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_NOT_OBOL">OVM_NOT_OBOL</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_READ_FAILED">OVM_READ_FAILED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_OWNER_REQUIRED">OVM_OWNER_REQUIRED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER">PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OWNERSHIP_HANDOVER_NOT_PENDING">OWNERSHIP_HANDOVER_NOT_PENDING</a> <span class="sdk-muted">plus the [checks every operation runs](../errors.md#checks-every-operation-runs)</span>

**Can report** <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--warning" href="../warnings#PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN" title="warning">PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--warning" href="../warnings#ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER" title="warning">ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--info" href="../warnings#ROLE_HOLDERS_UNCHECKED" title="info">ROLE_HOLDERS_UNCHECKED</a>

**Example**

```ts
// Sent by the current owner; OWNERSHIP_HANDOVER_NOT_PENDING without an unexpired request.
const complete = await obol.ovm.prepareCompleteOwnershipHandover({ ovm: ovmAddress, pendingOwner: account });
```

### ovm.prepareSetRewardRecipient {#prepareSetRewardRecipient}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">chain</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--throws">throws 4</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">1 warning</span></div>

Sets the reward recipient (`setRewardRecipient`); owner or SET_REWARD.

```ts sdk-signature
obol.ovm.prepareSetRewardRecipient(
  input: SetRewardRecipientInput,
): Promise<Prepared<'recipient'>>
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>input</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/ovm#SetRewardRecipientInput">SetRewardRecipientInput</a></span> |  |
| <code>input.ovm</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |
| <code>input.newRewardRecipient</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |
| <code>input.from?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">Promise&lt;<a href="./types/send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'recipient'&gt;&gt;</span>: a `Prepared` of kind `'recipient'`, preview <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/send#PreviewByKind">PreviewByKind</a>['recipient']</span>. Send it with [`obol.send`](./send.md#send) or your wallet layer.

**Throws** <span class="sdk-muted">(per spec)</span> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#CHAIN_READ_FAILED">CHAIN_READ_FAILED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_NOT_OBOL">OVM_NOT_OBOL</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_READ_FAILED">OVM_READ_FAILED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_ROLE_MISSING">OVM_ROLE_MISSING</a> <span class="sdk-muted">plus the [checks every operation runs](../errors.md#checks-every-operation-runs)</span>

**Can report** <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--warning" href="../warnings#PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN" title="warning">PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN</a>

**Example**

```ts
const setReward = await obol.ovm.prepareSetRewardRecipient({ ovm: ovmAddress, newRewardRecipient: account });
```

<details class="sdk-spec">
<summary>Specification: ovm role and ownership writes (shared section)</summary>

Tag: `chain`. Thin wrappers; each returns a [`Prepared`](./types/send.md#Prepared) (kinds `role`, `ownership`, `recipient`, `principalStake`,
`sweep`, `withdrawPullBalance`, `recoverFunds`; preview `{ function, args }`) calling the OVM function in the table.
Input and preview names follow the SDK's state names (`principalRecipient`), with the contract's "beneficiary" only in
the function names. The role bits keep the contract's constant names (`SET_BENEFICIARY`).
Shared checks, in order: the input checks of the table (the public forwarder checks need no chain read); `ovm`
provenance as `prepareWithdraw` 3; the sender's authority as below ([`OVM_ROLE_MISSING`](../errors.md#OVM_ROLE_MISSING) / [`OVM_OWNER_REQUIRED`](../errors.md#OVM_OWNER_REQUIRED)), read
on-chain. (2.16 wrappers; authority and forwarder checks new)

<div class="sdk-table">

| Operation                          | Contract call                                                                                      | Authority                      | Input checks                                                                                                                                                              |
| ---------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `prepareGrantRoles`                | `grantRoles(user, roles)`                                                                          | owner                          | `user` non-zero and not a public forwarder ([`PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_ROLE_HOLDER`](../errors.md#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_ROLE_HOLDER)); `roles` non-zero subset of `OVM_ROLES`                                                    |
| `prepareRevokeRoles`               | `revokeRoles(user, roles)`                                                                         | owner                          | same                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `prepareRenounceRoles`             | `renounceRoles(roles)`                                                                             | sender holds them              | `roles` as above                                                                                                                                                          |
| `prepareRequestOwnershipHandover`  | `requestOwnershipHandover()`                                                                       | anyone (the new owner)         | –                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `prepareCancelOwnershipHandover`   | `cancelOwnershipHandover()`                                                                        | requester                      | –                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `prepareCompleteOwnershipHandover` | `completeOwnershipHandover(pendingOwner)`                                                          | owner                          | `pendingOwner` non-zero and not a public forwarder ([`PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER`](../errors.md#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER)); `ownershipHandoverExpiresAt(pendingOwner)` > now, else [`OWNERSHIP_HANDOVER_NOT_PENDING`](../errors.md#OWNERSHIP_HANDOVER_NOT_PENDING) |
| `prepareTransfer`                  | `transfer(newPrincipalRecipient, newOwner)` (the contract's `beneficiary`)                         | owner                          | both non-zero; `newOwner` not a public forwarder ([`PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER`](../errors.md#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER))                                                                                            |
| `prepareSetPrincipalRecipient`     | `setBeneficiary(newPrincipalRecipient)` (the contract calls the principal recipient "beneficiary") | owner or `SET_BENEFICIARY`     | non-zero                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `prepareSetRewardRecipient`        | `setRewardRecipient(newRewardRecipient)`                                                           | owner or `SET_REWARD`          | non-zero                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `prepareSetAmountOfPrincipalStake` | `setAmountOfPrincipalStake(amount)`                                                                | owner or `SET_BENEFICIARY`     | `amount` uint256 wei                                                                                                                                                      |
| `prepareSweep`                     | `sweep(to, amount)` (the contract's `beneficiary` argument)                                        | anyone; owner when `to` is set | `amount` ≤ principal recipient's pull balance (0 = all); `to` default zero (= principal recipient)                                                                        |
| `prepareWithdrawPullBalance`       | `withdrawPullBalance(account)`                                                                     | anyone                         | `account` non-zero; pull balance 0 → [`NOTHING_TO_DISTRIBUTE`](../errors.md#NOTHING_TO_DISTRIBUTE)                                                                                                              |
| `prepareRecoverFunds`              | `recoverFunds(token, recipient)`                                                                   | owner or `RECOVER_FUNDS`       | both non-zero                                                                                                                                                             |

</div>

Previews and findings on these writes:

- `prepareSetAmountOfPrincipalStake`: preview `{ current, next, delta }` (wei, `delta` signed): raising it by 32 ETH
  means reward recipients get 32 ETH less at the next distribution.
- `prepareTransfer` and `prepareCompleteOwnershipHandover`: Finding [`ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER`](../warnings.md#ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER) (warning) listing the
  current non-owner role holders ([`ovm.getRoleHolders`](./ovm.md#getRoleHolders)), since a transfer does not revoke roles. Absent when there are
  none; if the holders cannot be read, Finding [`ROLE_HOLDERS_UNCHECKED`](../warnings.md#ROLE_HOLDERS_UNCHECKED) (info).
- `prepareGrantRoles`: Finding [`ROLE_GRANT_CONSOLIDATION`](../warnings.md#ROLE_GRANT_CONSOLIDATION) (warning) when `roles` includes `CONSOLIDATION` (the holder
  can consolidate every validator into one it controls, moving the whole stake); Finding
  [`ROLE_GRANT_DEPOSIT_TO_PRINCIPAL`](../warnings.md#ROLE_GRANT_DEPOSIT_TO_PRINCIPAL) (warning) when `roles` includes `DEPOSIT` and `user` is the principal recipient
  (it can raise `amountOfPrincipalStake` and take rewards as principal; see `getState`).

`transferOwnership` and `renounceOwnership` are not wrapped: `transfer` and the two-step handover cover the use, and
renouncing leaves an OVM without an owner. (2.16 did not wrap them either.)

</details>

<p class="sdk-see">See also: <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/operations.md#ovm-role-and-ownership-writes">spec/operations.md</a> · <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/spec/schemas/ovm.prepareSetRewardRecipient.json">input JSON Schema</a> · <a href="https://github.com/ObolNetwork/obol-sdk/blob/080fa554c999b11c014f3f09be26274014ded0b9/src/ovm/index.ts#L284">source</a></p>

### ovm.prepareSetAmountOfPrincipalStake {#prepareSetAmountOfPrincipalStake}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">chain</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--throws">throws 4</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">1 warning</span></div>

Sets `amountOfPrincipalStake` (`setAmountOfPrincipalStake`); owner or SET_BENEFICIARY.
The preview shows `current`, `next` and `delta`: raising it by 32 ETH pays the reward
recipients 32 ETH less at the next distribution.

```ts sdk-signature
obol.ovm.prepareSetAmountOfPrincipalStake(
  input: SetAmountOfPrincipalStakeInput,
): Promise<Prepared<'principalStake'>>
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>input</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/ovm#SetAmountOfPrincipalStakeInput">SetAmountOfPrincipalStakeInput</a></span> |  |
| <code>input.ovm</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |
| <code>input.amount</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint</span> | wei |
| <code>input.from?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">Promise&lt;<a href="./types/send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'principalStake'&gt;&gt;</span>: a `Prepared` of kind `'principalStake'`, preview <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/send#PreviewByKind">PreviewByKind</a>['principalStake']</span>. Send it with [`obol.send`](./send.md#send) or your wallet layer.

**Throws** <span class="sdk-muted">(per spec)</span> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#CHAIN_READ_FAILED">CHAIN_READ_FAILED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_NOT_OBOL">OVM_NOT_OBOL</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_READ_FAILED">OVM_READ_FAILED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_ROLE_MISSING">OVM_ROLE_MISSING</a> <span class="sdk-muted">plus the [checks every operation runs](../errors.md#checks-every-operation-runs)</span>

**Can report** <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--warning" href="../warnings#PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN" title="warning">PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN</a>

**Example**

```ts
import { parseEther } from 'viem';

const setStake = await obol.ovm.prepareSetAmountOfPrincipalStake({ ovm: ovmAddress, amount: parseEther('64') });
console.log(setStake.preview.current, '→', setStake.preview.next);
```

### ovm.prepareSweep {#prepareSweep}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">chain</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--throws">throws 5</span> <span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--warning">1 warning</span></div>

Sends the principal recipient's pull balance (`sweep`): to the principal recipient by
anyone, or to `to` by the owner. `amount` 0 sweeps all.

```ts sdk-signature
obol.ovm.prepareSweep(
  input: SweepInput,
): Promise<Prepared<'sweep'>>
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>input</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/ovm#SweepInput">SweepInput</a></span> |  |
| <code>input.ovm</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |
| <code>input.to?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> | Where the principal recipient's pull balance goes (the contract's `beneficiary` argument). Default: the principal recipient itself; any other address needs the owner. |
| <code>input.amount?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint</span> | wei; default 0 = the whole pull balance. |
| <code>input.from?</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type">Promise&lt;<a href="./types/send#Prepared">Prepared</a>&lt;'sweep'&gt;&gt;</span>: a `Prepared` of kind `'sweep'`, preview <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/send#PreviewByKind">PreviewByKind</a>['sweep']</span>. Send it with [`obol.send`](./send.md#send) or your wallet layer.

**Throws** <span class="sdk-muted">(per spec)</span> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#CHAIN_READ_FAILED">CHAIN_READ_FAILED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_NOT_OBOL">OVM_NOT_OBOL</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_READ_FAILED">OVM_READ_FAILED</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_ROLE_MISSING">OVM_ROLE_MISSING</a> <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--error" href="../errors#OVM_OWNER_REQUIRED">OVM_OWNER_REQUIRED</a> <span class="sdk-muted">plus the [checks every operation runs](../errors.md#checks-every-operation-runs)</span>

**Can report** <a class="sdk-chip sdk-chip--warning" href="../warnings#PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN" title="warning">PROVENANCE_UNKNOWN</a>

**Example**

```ts
const sweep = await obol.ovm.prepareSweep({ ovm: ovmAddress }); // `to` (owner only) sweeps elsewhere
```

  (it can raise `amountOfPrincipalStake` and take rewards as principal; see `getState`).

`transferOwnership` and `renounceOwnership` are not wrapped: `transfer` and the two-step handover cover the use, and
renouncing leaves an OVM without an owner. (2.16 did not wrap them either.)

| <code>input.account</code> | <span class="sdk-type">string</span> |  |

</div>
