<details class="sdk-spec">
<summary>Specification: ovm role and ownership writes (shared section)</summary>

Tag: `chain`. Thin wrappers; each returns a [`Prepared`](./types/send.md#Prepared) (kinds `role`, `ownership`, `recipient`, `principalStake`,
`sweep`, `withdrawPullBalance`, `recoverFunds`; preview `{ function, args }`) calling the OVM function in the table.
Input and preview names follow the SDK's state names (`principalRecipient`), with the contract's "beneficiary" only in
the function names. The role bits keep the contract's constant names (`SET_BENEFICIARY`).
Shared checks, in order: the input checks of the table (the public forwarder checks need no chain read); `ovm`
provenance as `prepareWithdraw` 3; the sender's authority as below ([`OVM_ROLE_MISSING`](../errors.md#OVM_ROLE_MISSING) / [`OVM_OWNER_REQUIRED`](../errors.md#OVM_OWNER_REQUIRED)), read
on-chain. (2.16 wrappers; authority and forwarder checks new)

<div class="sdk-table">

| Operation                          | Contract call                                                                                      | Authority                      | Input checks                                                                                                                                                              |
| ---------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `prepareGrantRoles`                | `grantRoles(user, roles)`                                                                          | owner                          | `user` non-zero and not a public forwarder ([`PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_ROLE_HOLDER`](../errors.md#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_ROLE_HOLDER)); `roles` non-zero subset of `OVM_ROLES`                                                    |
| `prepareRevokeRoles`               | `revokeRoles(user, roles)`                                                                         | owner                          | same                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `prepareRenounceRoles`             | `renounceRoles(roles)`                                                                             | sender holds them              | `roles` as above                                                                                                                                                          |
| `prepareRequestOwnershipHandover`  | `requestOwnershipHandover()`                                                                       | anyone (the new owner)         | –                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `prepareCancelOwnershipHandover`   | `cancelOwnershipHandover()`                                                                        | requester                      | –                                                                                                                                                                         |
| `prepareCompleteOwnershipHandover` | `completeOwnershipHandover(pendingOwner)`                                                          | owner                          | `pendingOwner` non-zero and not a public forwarder ([`PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER`](../errors.md#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER)); `ownershipHandoverExpiresAt(pendingOwner)` > now, else [`OWNERSHIP_HANDOVER_NOT_PENDING`](../errors.md#OWNERSHIP_HANDOVER_NOT_PENDING) |
| `prepareTransfer`                  | `transfer(newPrincipalRecipient, newOwner)` (the contract's `beneficiary`)                         | owner                          | both non-zero; `newOwner` not a public forwarder ([`PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER`](../errors.md#PUBLIC_FORWARDER_AS_OWNER))                                                                                            |
| `prepareSetPrincipalRecipient`     | `setBeneficiary(newPrincipalRecipient)` (the contract calls the principal recipient "beneficiary") | owner or `SET_BENEFICIARY`     | non-zero                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `prepareSetRewardRecipient`        | `setRewardRecipient(newRewardRecipient)`                                                           | owner or `SET_REWARD`          | non-zero                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `prepareSetAmountOfPrincipalStake` | `setAmountOfPrincipalStake(amount)`                                                                | owner or `SET_BENEFICIARY`     | `amount` uint256 wei                                                                                                                                                      |
| `prepareSweep`                     | `sweep(to, amount)` (the contract's `beneficiary` argument)                                        | anyone; owner when `to` is set | `amount` ≤ principal recipient's pull balance (0 = all); `to` default zero (= principal recipient)                                                                        |
| `prepareWithdrawPullBalance`       | `withdrawPullBalance(account)`                                                                     | anyone                         | `account` non-zero; pull balance 0 → [`NOTHING_TO_DISTRIBUTE`](../errors.md#NOTHING_TO_DISTRIBUTE)                                                                                                              |
| `prepareRecoverFunds`              | `recoverFunds(token, recipient)`                                                                   | owner or `RECOVER_FUNDS`       | both non-zero                                                                                                                                                             |

</div>

Previews and findings on these writes:

- `prepareSetAmountOfPrincipalStake`: preview `{ current, next, delta }` (wei, `delta` signed): raising it by 32 ETH
  means reward recipients get 32 ETH less at the next distribution.
- `prepareTransfer` and `prepareCompleteOwnershipHandover`: Finding [`ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER`](../warnings.md#ROLES_SURVIVE_TRANSFER) (warning) listing the
  current non-owner role holders ([`ovm.getRoleHolders`](./ovm.md#getRoleHolders)), since a transfer does not revoke roles. Absent when there are
  none; if the holders cannot be read, Finding [`ROLE_HOLDERS_UNCHECKED`](../warnings.md#ROLE_HOLDERS_UNCHECKED) (info).
- `prepareGrantRoles`: Finding [`ROLE_GRANT_CONSOLIDATION`](../warnings.md#ROLE_GRANT_CONSOLIDATION) (warning) when `roles` includes `CONSOLIDATION` (the holder
  can consolidate every validator into one it controls, moving the whole stake); Finding
  [`ROLE_GRANT_DEPOSIT_TO_PRINCIPAL`](../warnings.md#ROLE_GRANT_DEPOSIT_TO_PRINCIPAL) (warning) when `roles` includes `DEPOSIT` and `user` is the principal recipient
  (it can raise `amountOfPrincipalStake` and take rewards as principal; see `getState`).

`transferOwnership` and `renounceOwnership` are not wrapped: `transfer` and the two-step handover cover the use, and
renouncing leaves an OVM without an owner. (2.16 did not wrap them either.)

</details>

## Pure helpers {#group-helpers}

### ovm.routing {#routing}

<div class="sdk-badges"><span class="sdk-badge sdk-badge--tag" title="Where it reads from (spec tag)">pure</span></div>

Pure: how a distribution would route `balance` between the principal and reward
recipients, given the principal stake and threshold (as `getState` computes).

```ts sdk-signature
obol.ovm.routing(input: OvmRoutingInput): OvmRouting
```

<div class="sdk-table sdk-table--fields">

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <code>input</code> | <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/ovm#OvmRoutingInput">OvmRoutingInput</a></span> |  |
| <code>input.balance</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint</span> |  |
| <code>input.fundsPendingWithdrawal</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint</span> |  |
| <code>input.amountOfPrincipalStake</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint</span> |  |
| <code>input.principalThreshold</code> | <span class="sdk-type">bigint</span> | wei |

</div>

**Returns** <span class="sdk-type"><a href="./types/ovm#OvmRouting">OvmRouting</a></span>

**Example**

```ts
import { parseEther } from 'viem';

// Pure (also ovm.routing without a client): how a distribution would route the OVM's balance.
const routed = obol.ovm.routing({
  balance: parseEther('33'),
  fundsPendingWithdrawal: 0n,
  amountOfPrincipalStake: parseEther('32'),
  principalThreshold: parseEther('16'),
});
```
